## 6. If I Were Attacking This
For EVERY confirmed finding above (missing headers, content-discovery hits, vulnerable components, sqlmap results, ZAP alerts, forms) write one first-person line naming the exact tool/command you'd run, e.g. "`/rest/user/login` was found in the JS bundle, not linked anywhere - I'd `sqlmap -u <url> --data 'email=x&password=y' --batch --level=1 --risk=1` against it directly" or "ZAP flagged CORS misconfiguration on /ftp/ with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * - I'd check what's actually in that directory next since it's browsable cross-origin." Never invent a finding that isn't listed above. If a category above says nothing was found, write one line saying there's nothing to attack there yet, don't skip it silently.

## 7. ATT&CK-Aligned Next-Phase Plan
Tie section 6's actions to the three ATT&CK tactics that follow reconnaissance - every target named must come from section 6, not a new one:
   a. Resource Development (TA0042) - what to stage (wordlist, PoC page, cloned repo, etc).
   b. Initial Access (TA0001), non-human-targeting only - the actual entry-point attempt.
   c. Execution (TA0002) - what follows once that entry point succeeds.
